description: Generic codes every TechEazyHQ product raises the same way. Products add their own in META-INF/techeazy/error-dictionary.json. Do not rename or remove a released code.

entries.title: Request could not be read
entries.description: The body or a parameter could not be read or contains text the platform refuses.
entries.action: Send a well-formed request as the API describes.

entries.title: Parameter not valid
entries.description: A query or path parameter has the wrong form. The detail names it.
entries.action: Correct the parameter named in the detail.

entries.title: Request not valid
entries.description: One or more fields break a rule. The errors list names each field and its code.
entries.action: Correct each field in the errors list and send the request again.

entries.title: Sign-in required
entries.description: The request carries no valid credentials.
entries.action: Sign in and send the request with a valid token.

entries.title: Token not valid
entries.description: The token is expired, malformed, from another issuer or not meant for this service.
entries.action: Sign in again to get a new token.

entries.title: Not allowed
entries.description: The caller is signed in but may not do this.
entries.action: Ask an administrator for the access you need.

entries.title: Not found
entries.description: There is nothing at that address or with that id.
entries.action: Check the address or id.

entries.title: Method not allowed
entries.description: The address exists but does not accept that HTTP method.
entries.action: Use a method the address accepts; the Allow header lists them.

entries.title: Not acceptable
entries.description: The service cannot answer in any of the formats the Accept header asks for.
entries.action: Ask for application/json, or remove the Accept header.

entries.title: Unsupported media type
entries.description: The body is in a format the address does not accept.
entries.action: Send the body as application/json.

entries.title: Conflicting change
entries.description: The request conflicts with the current state, for example a newer version exists.
entries.action: Read the current state and send the change again.

entries.title: Request already used
entries.description: A signed or idempotent request was sent again with the same key or nonce.
entries.action: Send a new request with a new nonce or key.

entries.title: Too many requests
entries.description: The caller sent more requests than allowed in a short time.
entries.action: Wait for the time in the Retry-After header, then try again.

entries.title: Allowance used up
entries.description: The tenant has used its allowance for this period.
entries.action: Wait for the next period or ask for a larger plan.

entries.title: A required service is unavailable
entries.description: A service this request depends on cannot be reached right now. This is not a decision about the request.
entries.action: Try again after the time in the Retry-After header.

entries.title: Purpose of use missing
entries.description: The request touches personal data and does not say why. Every such request carries its purpose of use.
entries.action: Send the X-Purpose-Of-Use header with the code of the purpose.

entries.title: Purpose of use not valid
entries.description: The purpose of use is repeated, is not written as a purpose code, or is not one of the platform's purposes.
entries.action: Send exactly one X-Purpose-Of-Use header with a code from the purpose catalogue.

entries.title: Consent does not allow this
entries.description: The person has not consented to this purpose, or has withdrawn consent. Nothing was done.
entries.action: Do not repeat the request. Ask through the consent journey if the purpose is still needed.

entries.title: Consent could not be checked
entries.description: The consent check did not answer in time or failed. This is not a refusal: nothing was done and the person was not asked again.
entries.action: Wait for the time in the Retry-After header and send the request again.

entries.title: Access could not be checked
entries.description: The access policy did not answer in time, failed, or could not decide. This is not a refusal: nothing was done.
entries.action: Wait for the time in the Retry-After header and send the request again.

entries.title: Something went wrong
entries.description: The platform failed unexpectedly. Nothing about the failure is sent to the caller.
entries.action: Try again later and quote the correlation id if it keeps happening.

entries.title: Problem code not in the dictionary
entries.description: A problem was raised with a code the error dictionary does not list.
entries.action: Add the code to the product dictionary and raise it from the code.

entries.title: Unexpected error
entries.description: A request ended with an unexpected error. The correlation id ties the log line to the caller's answer.
entries.action: Find the log line by the correlation id and fix the cause.
